properties.statement: Joined two instruments by hand to rank the tool surface by frequency x cost: call volume per tool from the transcript scanner (tools/surface_usage.py, 47 sessions) against a controlled per-tool cost run on a copy of the store (hard-coded arguments for the top 40, reads timed cold and warm, refusals recorded as unmeasured), then weighted reads by how often they actually follow a write. Nothing serves a cost-weighted ranking; the two halves live in two scripts and the join was a third.
